Not Worth the Wait or the Price
Apr 2026 • Family
Quan Goc Cu was packed with people, which initially made us think the food must be really good. 

The roadside setting with small stools does give it an authentic Vietnamese street-food feel, and I can see why people might enjoy the experience.

Unfortunately, the food didn't live up to our expectations. We had the banh mi, and honestly, I've had much better elsewhere. It was dry, plain and lacked flavour. For the price, I felt it was quite disappointing and not worth the money.

The service was another issue. The waiting time was quite long. They were very enthusiastic about pulling people in to eat, but once we were seated, it felt like there was no one around to take our order or attend to us.

Overall, I wouldn't recommend it based on our experience. If you're mainly looking for an "authentic" Vietnamese roadside experience with small stools and a" photo-worthy" setting, then perhaps give it a try. But if you're going mainly for the food, there are definitely better options.
